item.title: How Can BTS, Madonna & Shakira All Squeeze Into an 11-Minute World Cup Halftime Show?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast, I'm Katie, and I'm here with Keith. Today, we're talking about some exciting news: the first-ever World Cup halftime show, featuring Madonna, Shakira, and BTS.
Keith: That's right, Katie. These three superstars will be performing together at the 2026 World Cup final game on July 19th at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. But here's the catch: they only have 11 minutes to make it happen.
Katie: So, how do you think they'll share their time? One theory is that each act could get around three minutes to perform a medley of their new music and biggest hits, and then come together for a special performance of Shakira's new World Cup anthem, "Dai Dai".
Keith: We'll have to wait until July to find out, but in the meantime, let's talk about some other chart news. Noah Kahan is spending his third week at number one on the Billboard 200 albums chart with "The Great Divide". And interestingly, no rock album has spent at least three weeks at number one in over a decade.
Katie: That's right. And on the Billboard Hot 100 songs chart, Ella Langley is celebrating her 10th week at number one with "Choosin' Texas". Bruno Mars is also back in the top 10 with "Risk It All" after releasing a Spanish-language version of the song.
Keith: We're also expecting some big changes on the charts next week, with Drake releasing three new albums on Friday. And Harry Styles is kicking off his Together, Together Tour in Amsterdam.
Katie: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in to the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast. You can stream us on Billboard.com or download us on your favorite podcast provider.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Don't forget to subscribe to our podcast for more pop news, chart stats, and interviews with music stars. We'll see you next week!
